The following chart shows the features we currently support for each {{glossary.user interface (UI)}}. {{snippet.EV_Table_SupportedEachUI}} ## UI Experience Field Setup {{snippet.EV_UIExperienceSetup}} ## Using the Tabbed UI The Tabbed UI is the default UI for {{variable.Object_Event}}s created with {{variable.Component_EventWizard}}. (For {{variable.Object_Event}}s created with the {{variable.Component_EventBuilder}}, the default UI is the Dynamic UI.) The Tabbed UI will be used for all {{variable.Object_Event}}s unless the {{variable.Field_ETEvent_UIExperience}} field is changed. The "Tabbed" UI supports both FREE and PAID {{variable.Object_Event}}s and as many {{variable.Object_EventItem}}s as you want. ![Tabbed UI](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/Tabbed%20UI.png){height="" width=""}
